A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GAM-Agent research and contain readable main text and Appendices A–K. Text, equations, tables, figures, and case studies support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations in Tables 1–2, component ablations, and supplementary cost, uncertainty, hyperparameter, and case analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and appendix analyses, with several revised accuracy values.

M1.justification: The agent roles, uncertainty functions, claim parsing, evidence mapping, dynamic weighting, debate procedure, and termination rules remain unchanged in Section 2 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MMMU, MMBench, MVBench, and V*Bench, retaining the same logical-reasoning subset and visual case studies. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain DMAD, DMPL, ChatEval, MAD, and DebUnc, with SEAL retained for V*Bench. The commercial-model comparisons and Base-Debate comparator in Appendices A–B are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Reported splits, model configurations, metrics, agent counts, debate budgets, decoding, and Appendix I settings are unchanged. The revised scores are not accompanied by a stated protocol change.

E4.justification: The component and hyperparameter ablations, debate-round and termination studies, cost/uncertainty analyses, and six success/failure cases are retained. Appendix B.2 revises an isolated reported accuracy without changing the analysis question or design.

E5.justification: There are no added or revised run counts, seed disclosures, statistical tests, or statistical uncertainty procedures. Existing graphical uncertainty displays and predictive-uncertainty analyses are retained.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises GAM-Agent accuracies under unchanged reported settings. In MMMU/MMBench/MVBench order, Qwen2.5VL-72B changes from 70.88/91.97/74.03 to 70.98/91.82/74.12; InternVL3-78B changes from 75.07/91.49/82.77 to 75.01/91.53/82.62. Corresponding gains are updated, with rankings unchanged. Appendix B.2 also changes 91.97% to 91.82%, but Figure 6 retains 91.97%.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equilibrium assumptions and discussion, utility functions, and weight derivations in Section 2 and Appendices C.5 and D–G are retained. Changed delimiter sizing and equation layout do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: Both versions claim that uncertainty-aware, game-theoretic collaboration improves multimodal reasoning across four benchmarks. The headline 5–6% and 2–3% gains remain; the abstract rewrite does not substantively change contribution scope.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and efficiency/convergence interpretations remain unchanged. Appendices C.5 and K.2 retain the same limitations concerning fixed thresholds, confidently incorrect experts, semantic misalignment, and inadequate expert selection.

D1.justification: v2 newly states in the abstract that code is publicly available and supplies a repository link; v1 provides no such pointer. Hardware, hyperparameters, preprocessing information, and prompts are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds eight references to introductory citation groups, including HiVA, MAT-Agent, CF-VLM, and MM-CoT. Existing cited works and substantive research positioning remain. KABB's venue update is bibliographic rather than a new cited work.

P1.justification: v2 edits the abstract, adds funding acknowledgements, and replaces the preprint footer with conference information. The main narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: First-page formatting, local spacing and page breaks, and mathematical delimiter sizing change. Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–9 retain their designs and organization; the numerical table revisions are covered under E6.

improvement.justification: The new code-access pointer and abstract edits improve documentation, but the unexplained accuracy revisions introduce a reporting inconsistency: Appendix B.2 now gives 91.82% where Figure 6 still gives 91.97%; these agreed in v1. With the scientific substance otherwise unchanged, the limited documentation benefits and reduced numerical consistency do not establish a reliable net quality direction.
